name: Map Rotation
description: Rotates through a map list after each match, when the server sits empty or on a schedule, with !nextmap, !rtv votes and an admin !map command.
author: OpenCitadel

maps.description: Maps to rotate through, in order.

emptyMinutes.description: Rotate once after the server has been empty this long. 0 turns it off.

intervalMinutes.description: Rotate every N minutes while players are on (announced a minute ahead). 0 turns it off.

rtvRatio.description: Share of players who must type !rtv to change the map.

afterMatch.description: Play the next map in the rotation when a match ends.
